title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 008
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute edit variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Square corner frame with a diagonal pencil stroke crossing upward to the right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants editing shown inside a square compose frame rather than a loose pencil.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for standalone pencil icons when the visible square frame matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only selected edit variant built from an open square frame plus one diagonal stroke.

items.depicts_observation: Tilted pencil shape with a capped body and pointed tip line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs the simplest standalone pencil symbol for editing or writing.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for framed or baseline edit variants when the loose pencil silhouette is the cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows only the pencil body without a frame baseline or document badge.

items.depicts_observation: Tilted pencil shape with two spark stars around the body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants to show editing enhanced by an added spark or AI cue.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain pencil when the surrounding spark stars need to be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds two spark stars around the same tilted pencil shape used by edit_2.

items.depicts_observation: Tilted pencil shape with a short horizontal base line below the tip
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants editing shown as writing along a short baseline.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the loose pencil when the baseline under the tip is the visible differentiator.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a short baseline under the pencil, which is absent from edit_2.

items.depicts_observation: Tilted pencil shape on a base line with one spark star above
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a writing line icon that also carries a small spark enhancement cue.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain baseline pencil when the added spark star is part of the intended meaning.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot combines the baseline from edit_3 with one spark star hovering above the pencil.
